    (COALESCE(baseline_avg.critical_cases_avg, 0) - COALESCE(post_avg.critical_cases_avg, 0)) AS reduction_in_critical_cases,
    COALESCE(baseline_avg.deaths_avg, 0) AS baseline_deaths,

    FROM daily_reports dr
    INNER JOIN interventions i2 ON dr.region_id = i2.region_id
    WHERE TO_DATE(dr.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TO_DATE(i2.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

) baseline_avg ON i.region_id = baseline_avg.region_id AND i.intervention_id = baseline_avg.intervention_id

    COALESCE(ts.operational_signals, 0) AS operational_traffic_signals,
    COALESCE(rc.total_conditions, 0) AS total_road_conditions,
    COALESCE(rc.closed_conditions, 0) AS closed_road_conditions,
    rc.avg_repair_time,
    COALESCE(rc.emergency_count, 0) AS emergency_maintenance_counts,
    COALESCE(rm.total_maintenance, 0) AS total_maintenance_counts,
    rm.total_cost,
    rm.avg_cost,

FROM road_types rt
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT

        COUNT(*) AS total_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN signal_status = 'operational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operational_signals
    FROM traffic_signals

        SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_conditions,

BusinessCategoryPaths AS (

  FROM business_categories bc
  INNER JOIN CategoryPath cp ON bc.category_id = cp.category_id
  GROUP BY bc.business_id
),
TransactionSummary AS (
  SELECT business_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount
  FROM transactions
  GROUP BY business_id

ReviewSummary AS (

)
SELECT

  COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,

  COALESCE(rs.review_count, 0) AS review_count,

        WHEN COUNT(sp.user_id) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sp.participation_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sp.user_id), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS completion_rate,
    COUNT(f.feedback_id) AS feedback_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(sp.user_id) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(COUNT(f.feedback_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(sp.user_id), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS feedback_rate,
    a.average_satisfaction,
    a.average_usefulness,
    a.average_effectiveness,
    a.average_visual_attractiveness,
    a.average_intention,
    a.total_responses,
    a.response_rate
FROM surveys s
LEFT JOIN survey_participants sp ON s.survey_id = sp.survey_id
LEFT JOIN feedback f ON s.survey_id = f.survey_id
LEFT JOIN analytics a ON s.survey_id = a.survey_id
GROUP BY s.survey_id, s.survey_name, a.average_satisfaction, a.average_usefulness, a.average_effectiveness, a.average_visual_attractiveness, a.average_intention, a.total_responses, a.response_rate

    c.release_year,

  FROM content c
  JOIN content_genres cg ON c.content_id = cg.content_id
  JOIN genres g ON cg.genre_id = g.genre_id
  JOIN content_tags ct ON c.content_id = ct.content_id
  JOIN content_ratings cr ON c.content_id = cr.content_id
  WHERE g.genre_name IN ('Comedy', 'Drama')
    AND ct.tag_name IN ('80s', '90s')
),
actor_content AS (
  SELECT
    fc.*,
    TRIM(UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(fc.cast, ','))) AS actor
  FROM filtered_content fc
),
ranked_actors AS (
  SELECT
    actor,
    genre_name,
    rating,
    runtime,
    release_year,
    avg_genre_rating,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre_name ORDER BY rating DESC) AS rn
  FROM actor_content
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  LOWER(actor) AS top_actor,
  genre_name,

WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY rating DESC;

WITH US_Users AS (
    SELECT u.user_id
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.country = 'United States'
),
UserPrefs AS (
    SELECT up.user_id,
           up.preferred_genre,
           up.preferred_tempo_range,
           up.preferred_loudness_range,
           up.preferred_key
    FROM user_preferences up
    INNER JOIN US_Users us ON up.user_id = us.user_id
),
TrackEngagement AS (
    SELECT t.track_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT tal.user_id) AS unique_listeners,
           COUNT(tr.rating) AS total_ratings,
           AVG(tr.rating) AS avg_rating,
           COUNT(tc.comment_id) AS total_comments
    FROM tracks t
    LEFT JOIN track_access_logs tal ON t.track_id = tal.track_id
    LEFT JOIN track_ratings tr ON t.track_id = tr.track_id
    LEFT JOIN track_comments tc ON t.track_id = tc.track_id
    GROUP BY t.track_id
),
MatchScores AS (
    SELECT t.track_id,
           AVG(
               (CASE WHEN up.preferred_genre IS NOT NULL AND t.track_title ILIKE '%' || up.preferred_genre || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN up.preferred_tempo_range IS NOT NULL THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN up.preferred_tempo_range = 'low' AND t.tempo < 90 THEN 1
                        WHEN up.preferred_tempo_range = 'medium' AND t.tempo BETWEEN 90 AND 150 THEN 1
                        WHEN up.preferred_tempo_range = 'high' AND t.tempo > 150 THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN up.preferred_loudness_range IS NOT NULL THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN up.preferred_loudness_range = 'quiet' AND t.loudness < -20 THEN 1
                        WHEN up.preferred_loudness_range = 'medium' AND t.loudness BETWEEN -20 AND -10 THEN 1
                        WHEN up.preferred_loudness_range = 'loud' AND t.loudness > -10 THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN up.preferred_key IS NOT NULL AND t."key"::TEXT = up.preferred_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           ) / 4.0 AS match_score
    FROM tracks t
    CROSS JOIN UserPrefs up
    GROUP BY t.track_id
),
FinalScores AS (
    SELECT ms.track_id,
           (ms.match_score * 0.4) +
           (COALESCE(te.avg_rating, 0) / 5.0 * 0.3) +
           (COALESCE(te.total_comments, 0) / (SELECT GREATEST(1, MAX(total_comments)) FROM TrackEngagement) * 0.2) +
           (COALESCE(te.unique_listeners, 0) / (SELECT GREATEST(1, MAX(unique_listeners)) FROM TrackEngagement) * 0.1) AS final_score
    FROM MatchScores ms
    LEFT JOIN TrackEngagement te ON ms.track_id = te.track_id
)
SELECT track_id
FROM FinalScores
ORDER BY final_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH RECURSIVE EventTypeHierarchy AS (
    SELECT type_id, type_name, parent_type_id, type_name::TEXT AS full_path
    FROM event_types
    WHERE parent_type_id IS NULL OR parent_type_id = ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT et.type_id, et.type_name, et.parent_type_id, eh.full_path || ' -> ' || et.type_name
    FROM event_types et
    INNER JOIN EventTypeHierarchy eh ON et.parent_type_id = eh.type_id
),
EventMediaCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.event_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.image_id) AS image_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT v.video_id) AS video_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.audio_id) AS audio_count
    FROM events e
    LEFT JOIN images i ON e.event_id = i.event_id
    LEFT JOIN videos v ON e.event_id = v.event_id
    LEFT JOIN audio a ON e.event_id = a.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
CumulativeMedia AS (
    SELECT 
        event_id,
        image_count,
        video_count,
        audio_count,
        SUM(image_count) OVER (ORDER BY event_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_images,
        SUM(video_count) OVER (ORDER BY event_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_videos,
        SUM(audio_count) OVER (ORDER BY event_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_audios
    FROM EventMediaCounts
)
SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.name AS event_name,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT eh.full_path, '; ' ORDER BY eh.full_path) AS event_type_hierarchy,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ind.name, '; ' ORDER BY ind.name) AS individuals_involved,
    cm.image_count,
    cm.video_count,
    cm.audio_count,
    cm.cumulative_images,
    cm.cumulative_videos,
    cm.cumulative_audios
FROM events e
LEFT JOIN event_event_type eet ON e.event_id = eet.event_id
LEFT JOIN EventTypeHierarchy eh ON eet.type_id = eh.type_id
LEFT JOIN event_individual ei ON e.event_id = ei.event_id
LEFT JOIN individuals ind ON ei.individual_id = ind.individual_id
LEFT JOIN CumulativeMedia cm ON e.event_id = cm.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name, cm.image_count, cm.video_count, cm.audio_count, cm.cumulative_images, cm.cumulative_videos, cm.cumulative_audios
ORDER BY e.event_id;

    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(dp.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS month,
    AVG(dp.float_col) AS avg_float
FROM data_points dp
JOIN data_point_types dpt ON dp.id = dpt.data_point_id
JOIN data_types dt ON dpt.type_id = dt.type_id
WHERE dp.created_by = 1
  AND dp.data_source_id = 1
  AND dt.type_name = 'boolean'
  AND dp.float_col IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(dp.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(dp.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
HAVING AVG(dp.float_col) > 0.5
ORDER BY year, month;

SELECT 
    s.supplier_id,
    s.supplier_name,
    COUNT(po.order_id) AS total_orders,
    ROUND(
        AVG(CASE WHEN od.delivery_status = 'On Time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS on_time_delivery_percentage,
    ROUND(
        AVG(CASE WHEN qc.status = 'Pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS quality_control_pass_percentage
FROM 
    suppliers s
LEFT JOIN 
    purchase_orders po ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN 
    order_details od ON po.order_id = od.order_id
LEFT JOIN 
    quality_control qc ON od.relay_id = qc.relay_id
GROUP BY 
    s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name
ORDER BY 
    on_time_delivery_percentage DESC,
    quality_control_pass_percentage DESC;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    (
        COALESCE(lr.rank, 0) * -1 +
        COALESCE(wins.win_count, 0) * 10 +
        COALESCE(aces.ace_count, 0) * 2 -
        COALESCE(dfs.double_fault_count, 0)
    ) AS performance_score
FROM players p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player_id, rank
    FROM rankings r1
    WHERE r1.date = (
        SELECT MAX(r2.date)
        FROM rankings r2
        WHERE r2.player_id = r1.player_id
    )
) lr ON p.player_id = lr.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player1_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY player1_id
) wins ON p.player_id = wins.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(stat_value) AS ace_count
    FROM statistics
    WHERE stat_type = 'aces'
    GROUP BY player_id
) aces ON p.player_id = aces.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(stat_value) AS double_fault_count
    FROM statistics
    WHERE stat_type = 'double_faults'
    GROUP BY player_id
) dfs ON p.player_id = dfs.player_id
ORDER BY performance_score DESC;

SELECT

SELECT 
    s.sequence_id,
    s.sequence_description,
    c.country_name,
    STRING_AGG(sa.annotation_value, '; ') AS annotations,
    STRING_AGG(sm.metadata_key || '=' || sm.metadata_value, '; ') AS metadata,
    COALESCE(view_counts.view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(download_counts.download_count, 0) AS download_count
FROM sequences s
LEFT JOIN countries c ON s.country_id = c.country_id

GROUP BY s.sequence_id, s.sequence_description, c.country_name, view_counts.view_count, download_counts.download_count
